title: TMEP — Building in public
timingSource: Editorial reading pace; no speech alignment or synthesized voice

scenes.label: THE POSSIBILITY
title: Your voice.
A complete reel?
captions: What if I told you that you could create a professional reel
using just your voice, without spending hours editing?

scenes.label: MEET THE PROJECT
title: Meet TMEP.
Built in the open.
captions: That's exactly what I'm building with my new open-source project called TMEP.

scenes.label: THE PROBLEM
title: One reel.
So many moving parts.
captions: Creating a professional reel takes a lot of time.
You need to add captions, design motion graphics,
synchronize animations, and create smooth transitions.

scenes.label: THE QUESTION
title: What if it all
worked together?
captions: But what if all of this could be automated?

scenes.label: THE WORKFLOW WE'RE BUILDING
title: From your voice
to your next reel.
captions: and TMEP is being designed to analyze your speech,
generate synchronized captions, create relevant motion graphics,
and combine everything into a complete video.

scenes.label: YOUR FORMAT. YOUR CHOICE.
title: On camera.
Or entirely animated.
captions: You can even add your own facecam
or create an entire animated reel without showing your face.

scenes.label: OPEN SOURCE
title: Explore the code.
Build with us.
captions: And because it's open-source, anyone can explore the code,

scenes.label: BUILDING IN PUBLIC
title: Real work.
Real progress.
captions: and I'll be sharing its real progress, challenges, and results.

scenes.label: THIS IS JUST THE BEGINNING
title: Follow the build.
Shape what comes next.
captions: Follow along to see what we build!
